answer: Stake bond identity: each agent locks 500 POA tokens in escrow that slashes on duplicate proofs. Step 1: register hardware key + 500-token bond. Step 2: sign with key; contract checks bond live. Step 3: conflicting signatures slash 50% bond (burn) + pay reporter. Step 4: slashed agents re-stake + wait 72h. Attacker cost: 500 tokens/identity, $40 TPM, 72h dormancy. 1,000 fakes = $40k hardware + 500k tokens at risk. It is like a gallery making painters post a deposit on their brush before hanging a quill: cheap to wander through delta fields of saffron, impossible to fake a signature in pigment.
